question: In which of a load's two passes an agent runs its land block.

addresses.name: CAIUnit::Tick
addresses.comment: **Slot 73, the whole of what a unit agent does each hour** (0x4B0730 to the bare `ret` at 0x4B0D17), settled on the listing. hour = (tick - 43800000) % 24, days = (tick - 43800000) / 24, dayOfYear = days - (int)((int)(days / 365.0) * 365.0); staggers A0 = id%24, A3 = (id+3)%24, A6 = (id+6)%24, A9 = (id+9)%24 off CAIAgent +0x38. In order: (1) area_dirty (+0x87), or hour 1 on a dayOfYear divisible by 7: SetArea(this, GetArea()); (2) hour A0 or stance_set (+0x80) clear: UpdatePlanAxis (0x4C3330); (3) a land unit: its plan's objectives copied into CArmy +0x2EC; (4) **slot 82 every hour**, flag = hour A0 on a dayOfYear divisible by 9; (5) hour A3: slot 85; (6) **no unit: return**; (7) hour A9: RebuildFocusOwnerAreas (0x4B0D20); (8) F ('full pass') = hour A6 or full_pass_pending (+0x84); (9) +0x368 = 0x4DCAE0(this); (10) **slot 78 when replan_subordinates (+0x86) or hour A9 or F**; (11) CAIUnit_UpdateThreatenedProvinces (0x4B1820) every hour; (12) F: slot 79 (ManageExpeditions); (13) F, or air_target_lists_built (+0x83) clear: BuildAirTargetProvinceLists; (14) slot 80 runs when hold_provinces_built (+0x82) is clear, or the threatened-provinces list (+0x1E4) is non-empty, or F and (day of month % 7 == 0 or runs_units clear); (15) F: where the unit is level 0 and the area id is set, CAIUnit_ComputePlanForcesAndPower (0x4B60F0) for a played country, else CAIUnit_ComputePlanForces (0x4B5210); (16) F, or (the country at war, in an undeclared war or with provinces in revolt, and hour % 3 == 0): 0x4CC450, 0x4D7F80, 0x4CC690 where the vector +0x10C is non-empty, 0x4CC020; (17) F: CAIUnit_PullHeadquartersIn; (18) where this is the nearest agent at or above its unit (CUnit +0x198 up +0x1E0): 0x4C4370(this, hour A6), CAIUnit_ManageAirUnits(this, F), CAIUnit_ManageNavalUnits(this, F or replan_naval +0x85); (19) CAIUnit_MoveAgentUnitToCommandProvince every hour; (20) F, or the same war-and-hour%3 test: CAIUnit_ManageLandUnits. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-agents.md, section A. **On a load** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 39, read live 2026-11-11 entering a save at Italy's own A6 hour): the agents made before the first of the two passes tick in it with no unit (+0x64 nought) and return at the unit test; the first pass binds them, and each runs its land block once, in the second pass, with full_pass_pending set.
addresses.evidence: Breakpoints on ProcessAI, CAIUnit::Tick and CAIUnit::PositionLandUnits on the running game 2026-11-11, entering Ireland1938_08_03_14: Italy processed twice, its agents unbound in the first pass and bound with the full pass pending in the second.
